passes.name: Constant Folding
passes.explanation: Folded 2 constant expression(s) at compile time (t1 = 2 mul 3 evaluated to 6; t3 = 1 add 2 evaluated to 3). The value is fixed at build time so no runtime arithmetic is emitted.

passes.name: Dead Code Elimination
passes.explanation: Every temporary produced is read by a later instruction; nothing was dead.
